selection_principle: Choose encoding geometry and association structure for the task first; then select the smallest dimension that passes predeclared held-out quality/reliability constraints. Keep semantic width and local dynamical width separate.

dimension_policy.rule: Do not spend 128K/256K effort across every static task by default. Expand only when the smaller sweep fails a declared criterion or the workload is a specific continuous-dynamics experiment.

representation_families.caveat: Bundling majority introduces retrieval interference; record fan-in and full-index false-positive rate.
Compare majority / normalized bundling and classifier variants; storage and operations differ from packed binary.
4 bytes per coordinate per vector; report network working set, temporaries and movement, not just vector bytes.
Not an assumption about the active Symthaea path; include only with a justified task and equal-boundary baseline.

tasks.task: Symbolic facts, attribute lookup, compositional records
tasks.decision_rule: Choose smallest width satisfying field-retrieval and corpus-scale false-match constraints.
Select width and code geometry on validation splits only; report the cost-quality frontier.

tasks.task: Object/scene retrieval and recovery of bound attributes
tasks.decision_rule: Jointly tune width and code correlation; higher dimensionality does not automatically resolve highly correlated factors.

tasks.task: Noisy associative cleanup and nearest-neighbour recall
tasks.decision_rule: Measure errors at the intended production index size, not only on a small vocabulary.

tasks.task: Ordered events, n-grams, short text, and sequence similarity
tasks.decision_rule: Compare association scheme and sequence length before assuming that a larger D solves order interference.
Benchmark static features separately from temporal-order and continuous-state variants.

tasks.task: Irregularly sampled prediction, temporal association, and control
tasks.decision_rule: Keep 128K/256K exploratory; promote a profile only after operator, trajectory, task-quality and resource/cost gates pass.

tasks.task: Robotics and edge-world state with low-latency actions
tasks.decision_rule: Separate retrieval/composition from control-state evolution and measure task outcomes end to end.

tasks.task: Relational graphs, multi-hop lookup, hierarchical reasoning
tasks.decision_rule: Test whether hierarchy/segmentation reduces accumulated interference more cheaply than increasing width.
Measure new-task adaptation and old-task retention together; dimension alone is not a continual-learning strategy.
Never merge approximate/in-memory results into the exact-digital comparison without separate precision and system-boundary accounting.

validation_rules: Treat dimensions and association schemes as independent experimental factors.
Select D and encoding hyperparameters on training/validation splits, never the final test set.
Use chronological or subject/session-held-out splits for temporal and sensor tasks.
Report exact versus approximate precision tracks separately.
Record negative controls and losing configurations.
Unknown matrix cells are not passes.
Select the smallest dimension that meets predeclared quality, reliability, latency and memory constraints.
A dimension or representation recommendation is task-specific and versioned.

literature.title: Classification using hyperdimensional computing: a review with comparative analysis
literature.observation: Evaluates seven familiar HDC datasets plus 121 UCI datasets; key-value encodings perform strongly on tabular data and random projection can reduce encoding time.
literature.boundary: Does not establish the optimal Symthaea dimension or dynamical representation.

literature.title: Optimal hyperdimensional representation for learning and cognitive computation
literature.observation: Studies how dimension and code correlation trade off classification, retrieval and factorization; motivates a separate correlation-geometry sweep.
literature.boundary: Controlled synthetic/MNIST analysis, not a universal production ranking.

literature.title: Hyperdimensional computing: a framework for stochastic computation and symbolic AI
literature.observation: Reviews role-filler binding, bundling, permutation, key-value records, sequence encodings and associative memory.
literature.boundary: General methods survey; task choices still require target-workload evaluation.

literature.title: Liquid Time-constant Networks
literature.observation: Grounds liquid networks in time-continuous recurrent dynamics with varying time constants and time-series prediction.
literature.boundary: Not evidence that every high-dimensional semantic component must be numerically evolved.

interpretation_limits: This is an authored executable, not an executed benchmark result.
Bipolar-valued ContinuousHV f32 is a binding/unbinding control; not native uniform[-1,1] ContinuousHV and not dynamical LTC/CfC qualification.
Small negative-pair samples cannot demonstrate extreme rare-event false-positive rates.
Choose thresholds on calibration data and use held-out evaluation; include number of comparisons made by the intended query pattern.
capacity_curve_experiment.multiplicity_rule: For per-comparison false-match probability p and M comparisons, use conservative union bound P(any false match) <= min(1, M*p). A single query over N records uses M=N; all unordered pairs use M=N*(N-1)/2.
